name: blockyard
description: A free Mac app for hosting Minecraft servers: Paper, Purpur, Fabric, Forge, NeoForge and Vanilla, with a console, players, plugins, crossplay and public access.
author: Ek2100

scripts.test:ui: xvfb-run -a electron --no-sandbox test/ui-harness.js && xvfb-run -a electron --no-sandbox test/ui-features.js && xvfb-run -a electron --no-sandbox test/ui-v12.js && xvfb-run -a electron --no-sandbox test/ui-update.js
scripts.screenshots: xvfb-run -a -s "-screen 0 3000x2200x24" electron --no-sandbox scripts/screenshots/capture.js && SHOT_THEME=dark xvfb-run -a -s "-screen 0 3000x2200x24" electron --no-sandbox scripts/screenshots/capture.js
